scope: Self-contained basic-model candidate discovery in every existing decoded overlay mapping. Loader destination and filename literals are re-read from original main code; every decoded image hash is checked. Physical/cached/uncached RAM aliases are resolved for reads without rewriting input bytes.
limitations: Bounded structural scan only. Models with cross-image pointers, relative/relocated pointers, alternative layouts or unsupported counts/groups can be absent. Same-address records in different modules are distinct; counts do not measure unique artwork, full asset coverage or game reachability.
Profiles use original static flags; runtime overrides and actual near-plane crossings remain separate questions. No new recovered game-code credit or completed port claim.
